[editor](../index.md) / parseCollectionFaces

# Function: parseCollectionFaces()

> **parseCollectionFaces**\<`Buffer`\>(`file`): readonly readonly `Readonly`\<`Uint8Array`\<`ArrayBuffer` \| `Buffer`\>\>[][]

Defined in: io/font-collection/parse-collection-faces.ts:17

Reads the faces a font file holds, each as the parts of a font file of its own: a collection
(`.ttc`, its header `ttcf`) gives each of its faces' parts (`collectionFaceToParts`), views of
its bytes, in the order of its `tableDirectoryOffsets`; any other file is given back as it is,
one face of one part, or none.

## Type Parameters

### Buffer

`Buffer` *extends* `ArrayBufferLike`

the buffer the bytes sit in, kept by every view of them

## Parameters

### file

`Readonly`\<`Uint8Array`\<`Buffer`\>\>

the bytes of a font file or of a collection

## Returns

readonly readonly `Readonly`\<`Uint8Array`\<`ArrayBuffer` \| `Buffer`\>\>[][]

the parts of each face, joined in their order into its file; the file itself when it
is not a collection

## Kind

format
